manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. The gate releases a second ball at that moment. Both then fall together from rest.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball side by side, with velocity and acceleration vectors and readouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
